en: Vintage sepia postcard showing a tall medieval city tower rising from a gateway at the edge of a town square. Surrounding the tower are low historic buildings and a larger neoclassical school building. People walk and ride horse-drawn carriages across the square. The captions in German at the top identify the scene as Bautzen with the Reichenturm and the industrial and trade school.
